name: COUNT_STAR_VS_COUNT_COL_WITH_NULLS
description: count(*) counts rows; count(col) ignores NULL values

name: SUM_AVG_IGNORE_NULL
description: sum and avg skip NULL inputs; avg = sum/count(non-null)

name: SUM_AVG_ALL_NULL_RETURNS_NULL
description: sum/avg over all-NULL input returns NULL (not 0)

name: SUM_EMPTY_RETURNS_NULL
description: sum() over empty table is NULL; count is 0; avg is NULL

name: TOTAL_VS_SUM_ALL_NULL_AND_EMPTY
description: total() returns 0.0 on empty AND all-NULL; sum() returns NULL

name: MIN_MAX_IGNORE_NULL
description: min/max skip NULLs; over all-NULL input return NULL

name: GROUP_CONCAT_SKIPS_NULL
description: group_concat skips NULL inputs but joins remaining

name: GROUP_CONCAT_ALL_NULL_RETURNS_NULL
description: group_concat over all-NULL input returns NULL

name: COUNT_DISTINCT_EXCLUDES_NULL
description: count(DISTINCT col) excludes NULL entirely; distinct values only

name: DISTINCT_ALL_NULL_COUNT_ZERO
description: count(DISTINCT col) over all-NULL is 0; SELECT DISTINCT yields single NULL row

name: FILTER_WHERE_IS_NOT_NULL
description: FILTER (WHERE x IS NOT NULL) restricts the rows fed to aggregates

name: GROUP_BY_NULL_KEY_COLLAPSES
description: GROUP BY with NULL key groups all NULLs into one group

name: HAVING_SUM_NULL_FILTERED
description: HAVING sum(v) IS NOT NULL drops all-NULL groups (NULL is not truthy)

name: AVG_TYPEOF_REAL_WITH_NULLS
description: avg always returns REAL even on integer input with NULLs
